title: EIDER: Empowering Document-level Relation Extraction with Efficient Evidence Extraction and Inference-stage Fusion
reasoning: The paper includes an error analysis section (A.2) that discusses different types of model failures. One specific 'Error Type 2: Fail in Commonsense Reasoning' provides an example where the model fails to infer a relation involving a 'Catholic priest' and 'pope', requiring commonsense knowledge about 'Religion'. This constitutes a component dealing with religion in its evaluation.
